create_cpm_tokenizer: create a CpmTokenizer instance from a SentencePiece vocab file for CPM model tokenization
tokenize_text_cpm: tokenize a text string using CpmTokenizer with SentencePiece and Jieba-RS segmentation
build_special_token_sequence: build model inputs with special tokens (sep, cls) from a pair of token ID sequences for CpmTokenizer
create_token_type_ids_cpm: create token type ID masks from token sequences for sequence-pair classification with CpmTokenizer
save_cpm_vocabulary: save the CpmTokenizer vocabulary to a directory as a SentencePiece model file
